audit.whatIsWrong: win[3]/phases[3].side read 'Skill' while whys[3] says 'Levels 4-5 favour Yorick as ghoul %HP chip beats Mundo's passive regen in lane', and mid describes the whole stretch from 2 through 6 as yours.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Yorick, Yorick) agrees with the prose. Every other row already matches.
audit.corrected: Row 3 flipped across both layers as a matched pair; the rest of the chart is already correct and left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Goes Where He Pleases is never mentioned anywhere on the page — not in the full layer, not in the content layer, not in the report.
audit.why: Dr. Mundo RESISTS THE FIRST IMMOBILISING EFFECT that hits him, taking health damage and dropping a cannister he can walk over to heal and cut the passive's cooldown. Against a champion whose whole pattern is mark-slow-cage-swarm, the fact that his first CC is free is a lane-defining fact, and it is the reason a jungle gank sequenced wrong achieves nothing. The page also never mentions his significantly increased health regeneration except as a vague 'regen'.
audit.corrected: early now names Goes Where He Pleases and states that the first immobilise is resisted and that his regen refills poke damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claims 'he can't cleaver you through the wall' and wants.you[0] says 'W to wall off his Q cleaver'. Both treat Dark Procession as a projectile blocker.
audit.why: Riot's text for Dark Procession says only that it blocks enemy MOVEMENT, and nothing in either description settles whether the wall stops Infected Bonesaw's missile. The kits are silent, so this is unknown, not confirmed — and the page states it as fact in two places. Worse, the wall is destructible, so a caged Mundo can simply hit it down, which the page never says. What Mourning Mist actually contributes here is the mark that accelerates every Mist Walker toward him plus the armour shred, and that was absent.
audit.corrected: Wall lines rewritten around caging the retreat and the wall being destructible; Mourning Mist's mark and armour shred stated. The projectile-blocking claim is removed rather than replaced with the opposite claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' (sequencingCues 0). Heart Zapper is named as the tracked cooldown in twelve fields with no number and no description of what it actually does.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1. It stores a portion of the damage he takes and heals him a percentage of that stored damage when the burst hits an enemy — so fighting INTO it feeds the heal, and the window to commit is after it pops. Infected Bonesaw is 4s and deals current-health damage; Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: The 17s and the store-then-heal mechanic now appear in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; Infected Bonesaw's 4s and current-health scaling in early and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is named in the TL;DR and itemization but dosFull[2].d, under the heading 'Anti-heal his regen', described a wasted Heart Zapper instead.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal' names both Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage. Maximum Dosage instantly heals a percent of MISSING health and then regenerates a portion of maximum health over a long duration — percent-health healing, which is why the ghoul chip strategy needs Grievous Wounds up before he ults, not after.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names both healing abilities as the anti-heal targets.

edits.before: Level 1 is even farm — Mundo throws Q Infected Bonesaw cleavers at the wave to poke and slow, and you sidestep them while last-hitting with Q Last Rites. His passive regen makes early poke wars pointless, so don't burn HP trying to zone a champ who just heals it back. Soak XP and set up for your level-2/3 spike.
edits.after: Level 1 is even farm — Infected Bonesaw (4s) chunks you off your current health and slows, so sidestep it and last-hit with Last Rites. Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilise that hits him, and his regen refills whatever you poke off, so don't start an HP war. Soak XP and set up your level-2/3 spike.

edits.before: W caging Mundo plus E-slow lets you free-hit him and deny his Q Infected Bonesaw skillshot; he can't cleaver you through the wall and your ghouls shred his health bar faster than his passive regen.
edits.after: Mourning Mist marks Mundo, shreds his armour and sprints your ghouls at him; Dark Procession cages the retreat, though it is destructible and he will swing at it. Bring Grievous Wounds — his regen beats raw chip.

edits.after: Wall his retreat, not his Q

notes: The biggest gap here was not an error but an absence: Goes Where He Pleases does not appear anywhere on the page. A Yorick player whose entire plan is Mourning Mist plus Dark Procession plus a jungle gank needs to know the first immobilising effect thrown at Mundo is eaten by his passive and hands him a healing cannister. I put it in early, which is the only field with room. It deserves a dedicated dosFull or dontsFull entry too, but every slot in those arrays is already occupied by other correct advice and the entry counts must not change. UNVERIFIED and therefore removed rather than reversed: whether Dark Procession blocks Infected Bonesaw's missile. The page asserted it does, in two places; Riot's text for the wall says it blocks enemy movement and says nothing about projectiles, so I cut the claim instead of asserting the opposite.
